mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms ( customer_id, status, response_status, created_at, updated_at, last_message_id ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, 'OPEN', 'WAITING_ADMIN', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms SET last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, last_message_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), response_status = #{responseStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{chatRoomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages ( chat_room_id, sender_id, product_id, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{chatRoomId}, #{senderId}, #{productId}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO chat_message_attachments ( chat_message_id, object_key, original_filename, content_type, file_size, display_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{chatMessageId}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{displayOrder}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message_attachments WHERE chat_message_id = #{chatMessageId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_read_cursors ( chat_room_id, reader_side, last_read_message_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{chatRoomId}, #{readerSide}, #{lastReadMessageId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_message_id = VALUES(last_read_message_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO customer_admin_notes ( customer_id, content, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{content}, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO chat_room_orders ( chat_room_id, order_id, conversation_anchor_message_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{chatRoomId}, #{orderId}, #{conversationAnchorMessageId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = VALUES(order_id), conversation_anchor_message_id = VALUES(conversation_anchor_message_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_room_orders WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
